title: Code and data for: Symmetry purity from two Casimir moments: partial dynamical symmetry in the interacting boson model, from exact spectra to a quantum processor
description: Source code, verification scripts, logs and the recorded IBM Quantum (ibm_kingston) output for the manuscript "Symmetry purity from two Casimir moments: partial dynamical symmetry in the interacting boson model, from exact spectra to a quantum processor" by Dhritimalya Roy (arXiv:2608.04486; revised version). Version 2.0.0 accompanies the revised manuscript, whose earlier title was "State-resolved quantum-information fingerprints of partial dynamical symmetry in the interacting boson model".
